doctorAbout.full_description: Dr. Abhinandan S Punit has undergone extensive training in Traumatology and Orthopedics with esteemed national and international institutions. He completed his Master of Surgery in Orthopedics from Kasturba Medical College in 2011 and was awarded DNB Orthopedics in 2012 from the National Board of Examinations. Dr. Punit has received advanced surgical training in hip, knee, and shoulder surgeries from prestigious hospitals in the United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia for nearly five years. He holds several notable international degrees. With a distinguished academic background, Dr. Punit has numerous national and international papers, research, and conference presentations to his credit. His areas of special interest include navigated and robotic hip and knee replacement, minimally invasive hip replacement (anterior approach), shoulder surgeries, and sports medicine, including hip arthroscopy. He has performed over 6000 surgeries and has worked with both amateur and elite athletes, including those from the Sports Authority of India, Bangalore. Currently he is working at Narayana Health City, Bengaluru, as a Clinical Lead for robotic joint replacement and arthroplasty.
